# 7 Deadly Sins Test

> An English self-reflection quiz about everyday habits. Visitors answer 21 statements and receive seven scores from 0 to 12, with readings about their leading tendencies and balancing virtues.

Three statements contribute to each score, including one reverse-scored statement. If the two highest scores are within one point, both appear as dominant. The public readings below describe each tendency. A visitor's personal scores are calculated in the browser.

## Quiz and guide

- [Take the test](https://7deadlysinstest.one/): Start the quiz or resume saved progress on the same device.
- [Explore the seven sins](https://7deadlysinstest.one/#seven-sins): Illustrated cards with examples from everyday life.
- [Frequently asked questions](https://7deadlysinstest.one/#faq): Scoring, dual results, saving progress, and sharing a comparison invitation.

## Public result readings

- [Pride](https://7deadlysinstest.one/result/pride/): Recognition, defensiveness, and humility.
- [Greed](https://7deadlysinstest.one/result/greed/): Wanting more, sharing resources, and generosity.
- [Lust](https://7deadlysinstest.one/result/lust/): Attraction, personal boundaries, and chastity.
- [Envy](https://7deadlysinstest.one/result/envy/): Social comparison, celebrating others, and kindness.
- [Gluttony](https://7deadlysinstest.one/result/gluttony/): Pleasure, noticing satisfaction, and temperance.
- [Wrath](https://7deadlysinstest.one/result/wrath/): Anger, recurring arguments, and patience.
- [Sloth](https://7deadlysinstest.one/result/sloth/): Avoidance, getting started, and diligence.
